title: 進路セミナーⅡ
subtitle: Career Planning  Seminar II
educationalGoal:
The main subjects of the course are the following three:
1. Practice in self-analysis and career design
2. Search for self-future direction with making to improve in job consciousness by lectures both experts working on and seniors in job hunting, etc.
3. Initiate activity with planning in the subjects required for a long period on the written exams of qualification acquisition, general common sense, and SPI, etc.

requiredKnowledge: It is due to perform the career planning seminar II carried out the practical course towards job-hunting activities of next year, and to make the preparation and strategy to the severe job-hunting expected. All students need to take a lecture irrespective of a future direction, because it is necessary to make preparations of mental attitude and employment exam for job-hunting activities. Moreover, this study result will precede as reference data of concrete guidance counseling.
